case_flag_waiver_check.name: case_flag_waiver_check
case_flag_waiver_check.value: "clear"."case_flag"."status" <> 'waived' or ("clear"."case_flag"."waive_reason" is not null and "clear"."case_flag"."waived_at" is not null)

sales_contract_unit_price_check.name: sales_contract_unit_price_check
sales_contract_unit_price_check.value: ("clear"."sales_contract"."unit_price" is null) = ("clear"."sales_contract"."price_currency" is null) and ("clear"."sales_contract"."unit_price" is null) = ("clear"."sales_contract"."price_unit" is null) and ("clear"."sales_contract"."unit_price" is null or "clear"."sales_contract"."unit_price" > 0)

trade_sme_register_scores_ck.name: trade_sme_register_scores_ck
trade_sme_register_scores_ck.value:
("trade"."sme_register"."costing_knowledge" is null or "trade"."sme_register"."costing_knowledge" between 1 and 5)
        and ("trade"."sme_register"."production_capacity_strength" is null or "trade"."sme_register"."production_capacity_strength" between 1 and 5)
        and ("trade"."sme_register"."documentation_knowledge" is null or "trade"."sme_register"."documentation_knowledge" between 1 and 5)
        and ("trade"."sme_register"."financial_record_keeping" is null or "trade"."sme_register"."financial_record_keeping" between 1 and 5)
        and ("trade"."sme_register"."market_readiness" is null or "trade"."sme_register"."market_readiness" between 1 and 5)
